# Theme brief: Projects tab project pages

Used by `/projects/*/`. Tokens: `/projects/project-theme.css`. Art direction: docs/DESIGN.md, "Individual projects".
Retro arcade: night `#0B0420`, pink `#FF4FD8`, cyan `#3DF2FF`, yellow `#FFE14D`. Press Start 2P for headings only,
IBM Plex Mono for text. CRT curvature and scanlines in CSS, stepped 8-bit motion. Photos here are stock (credited on
each page); show them on a "cabinet screen". Hardware pages (FPGA, sensor node, bench rig) can use pixel-art chips,
batteries and scope traces.
